acceptanceCriteria: Protocol-owned parameter facts are the only source for names, types, requiredness, defaults, enums, aliases, and descriptions in the trial surface.
CLI help and MCP schema projections are tested against the same protocol facts; a changed fact changes both projections without a second hand-maintained value.
Generated reference regions remain deterministic in English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese, and human prose outside the region is preserved.
Description discovery remains read-only and starts zero verification or repository-history scans.
The implementation plan records the bounded files, interfaces, red-green tests, and verification sequence without expanding lifecycle or release scope.
Agent-managed guidance requires adapters to pass the active conversation language explicitly to CLI --language or MCP language; direct CLI locale fallback remains only a fallback.
The localized Outcome contract is tested through the installed adapter guidance without changing Contract source text, JSON field names, or governance facts.
goal: 同一接口事实只从协议拥有的定义投影到 CLI 帮助、MCP schema 和三语参考，变更一个定义后无需分别修改各适配层。
intent: 消除 work-item outcome 接口事实在 CLI、MCP 和协议描述之间的手工重复维护，保留现有权限、生命周期和 Outcome 语义。
outOfScope: Outcome delivery and host messaging behavior
